summary: Cleone Campground: no operator website (cleonecampground.com parked since 2022; Wayback has only a 2021 page) and no booking engine; RoverPass is an unclaimed listing ($35 table, 11/2024, not usable). Presence passes on Google: 'Cleone Grocery Campground' 4.6 (97), (707) 964-4589, open, recent camping reviews. Price indicator is only RV Life $$ (stored). Cleared aggregator-only hookups, site count, wifi and booking; showers/laundry kept as camper-reported. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin OK.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): no 2024+ operator rate anywhere (no site, no engine). The only figure is the unclaimed RoverPass table ($35 RV / $31 tent, 'Last Updated: 11/15/2024'), which does not count. RV Life $$ tier stored stands in for price (ordinary transient campground, not long-stay in character). Not a Good Sam Park. No gateway within 40 km (Redwood NP 201 km). Family has not stayed here.

PRESENCE: passes only via Google Maps - 'Cleone Grocery Campground', 4.6 from 97 reviews, phone (707) 964-4589, not marked closed, a review 'a month ago' from a long-time camper. The rating listing is shared with the Cleone Grocery store ('Located in: Cleone Grocery'), so it is not purely the campground's.
GOOGLE REVIEWS: 4.6 (97). One review 4 months ago calls it 'Basically a rundown dump' (laundry, dead animal); the others read well. Not under 4.0.
